This is a static (cached) page w/ the '''[[SerComm]]''' device query stuff<small>, for lack of anything currently better.</small>
It's just a table of most/all devices likely to be manufactured by '''[[SerComm]]''' within [https://wikidevi.com the '''WikiDevi''' DB]. :It's most certainly '''incomplete''' and inaccurate to some degree. If a device is listed here, it doesn't necessarily mean it is affected by the '''TCP-32764''' issue.
